name: olio.pb.castGroup
label: Cast Group
description: A named collective entity (herd, crowd, ensemble) that a canvas chip can bind to as a single unit. A binding references it via refModel='olio.pb.castGroup' + refObjectId. Members are olio.charPerson records tracked via the pb.castGroup.member participation table.

fields.name: series
fields.description: Set on a series-scoped BASELINE cast group (the canonical charPerson per character, shared across chapters). A per-chapter SHADOW cast group leaves this null and sets 'book' instead. Distinct names avoid the (name, groupId, organizationId) constraint colliding across the two tiers.
